title: Reload Apache after a configuration test
description: Test the Apache configuration and reload the service only when the test passes.

linuxCommandTemplate.name: apachectl
linuxCommandTemplate.commandPattern: sudo apachectl configtest && sudo systemctl reload {service}

parameters.name: service
parameters.label: Service unit
parameters.description: Apache unit name: httpd on RHEL and derivatives, apache2 on Debian and Ubuntu

examples.command: sudo apachectl configtest && sudo systemctl reload httpd
examples.description: Reload Apache on RHEL when the configuration is valid

examples.command: sudo apachectl configtest && sudo systemctl reload apache2
examples.description: Reload Apache on Debian or Ubuntu when the configuration is valid
Restart gracefully through apachectl, which tests the configuration first

notes: Requires sudo. A reload lets the children finish their current requests.

links.title: apachectl - Apache HTTP Server Control Interface

fr.title: Recharger Apache après un test de configuration
fr.description: Teste la configuration Apache et ne recharge le service que si le test réussit.
fr.notes: Nécessite sudo. Un rechargement laisse les processus enfants terminer leurs requêtes en cours.
